sources.label: Standalone, app-specific patches for use with Morphe
sources.author: kveld9 Extra
patch_list: Blocks ad loaders and unlocks ad-free status.
Keeps HTTP cleartext for LAN printers and driver downloads and trusts user certificates. Less strict than stock; on by default because some printers need it, disable for maximum strictness.
Deletes hidden ad files and trackers to shrink the app.
Disables payment components for other app stores you do not use.
Skips the first-launch popup (the About menu still works).
Stops background tasks that drain the battery.
